title: Koki au soja (Cowpea and Soy Koki)
author: Tata Ngome et al. (CIFOR-ICRAF, IRAD, Université de Ngaoundéré)
desc: Half a cup each of cowpeas and soy ground and beaten as for koki, mixed with slightly heated palm oil, salt and four large chillies, tied in flamed banana leaves or plastic and steamed 2 hours.
longDesc: The soy variant of the book’s koki. The method follows the cowpea koki (CMR023): soak about an hour, rinse, grind, beat 30 minutes in a mortar in one direction, add slightly heated palm oil in portions, then salt, then water until the dough holds together. The book allows wrapping in flamed banana leaves tied with string or in plastic. Steam 2 hours. The same ‘200 g de sel’ appears in the ingredient line and is reported as printed.
ingredients: 1/2 cup cowpeas (niébé; cup size not printed)
200 g salt (as printed — a suspected misprint)
Water as needed — quantity not printed
steps: Soak the cowpeas and soy about an hour. Rinse several times.
Grind to a paste, then turn it in a mortar, always in one direction, for 30 minutes.
Add the slightly heated palm oil in portions, then salt. Add water until the dough holds together.
Wrap in flamed banana leaves tied with string, or in plastic. Steam for 2 hours.
chefTips: Same cues as CMR023: light paste after the beating, dough that holds together.
The salt figure is as printed; check it first.
Soy and cowpea are measured by the cup; the cup size is not printed.
commonMistakes: Salting at the printed 200 g without checking.
Undercooking: the page gives only the 2-hour time.
healthBenefits: Soy and cowpeas together raise plant protein; palm oil adds fat.
culturalNote: As in the rest of the book, no community is named. This is the soy-enriched variant of the cowpea koki.
sources: Title as printed: ‘Koki au soja’ (p. 44). Authors as printed: ‘Tata Ngome et al.’; October 2023 (V1), © 2024, CC BY 4.0. Printed times: soaking 1 hour, cooking 2 hours. Yield not printed (servings 4 is a placeholder). TWO-PASS.
SUSPECTED MISPRINT, reported as printed: ‘200 g de sel’. The method also says the chilli is optional while the list gives 4 large chillies.
